_instructions: Set truth_mm for real measured dimensions.  kind may be 'euclidean', 'horizontal' or 'vertical'.  Height tests use the inferred up direction and either the board surface or a named reference point.  Set board_thickness_mm to the board's measured top-surface height above the tank floor.  Optionally set physical_baseline_mm for a comparison only; it never rescales the reconstruction.  Set tank_transform_verified=true only if the board->tank transform in tank_alignment.npz is a measured, verified transform.  floor_reference_points are used only for a least-squares plane-consistency check and the 3-D plot; they do not redefine the height zero (which is the board surface plus board_thickness_mm).  Use identical point and test names across repeated captures so per-test repeatability can be assessed.
